//: 🤖 Screenshots for the homepage apps carousel (src/_includes/home-body.njk, src/home/apps.js). Each is the app's public landing page, captured with headless Chromium at a 1280x800 light viewport, saved 360, 720 and 960 pixels wide (360x225; 720x450 and 960x600 for sharp 2x screens) as AVIF, WebP and a JPEG fallback (<app>-360.*, <app>-720.*). Names, descriptions, logos and links come from the Apps page (src/apps/index.html): `app` is the file name of the Apps page card's logo (tito for /apps/logos/tito.svg), and `url` must be the Apps page's own link, or the build fails. `gallery` is the explicit exception: a name or url the carousel shows instead, each with the reason; an override that matches the Apps page is stale and also fails the build. `logoSpells` is the text a wordmark logo already spells: that part of the name is shown by the logo alone (and stays the logo's alt text), so it is not printed twice. Listed in the Apps page order.

skipped.keymail: the public page at keymail.dev is only a sign-in screen
skipped.kass: the public page at home.kass.training is only a sign-in screen
skipped.ocho: the public page at ocho.chat is only a sign-in screen
skipped.oficina apps: one slide, not six: docs, sheets, slides, calendar, calls and memoria.oficina.works all go straight to the shared sign-in, and oficina.works/<app> is 404; oficina.works is the only public page and lists all six (checked 2026-11-13)
